insSteps: If the pork roast is not prepared yet, use thread to keep the pieces compact and together. This makes sure that the meat doesn't dry too much while roasting.
Peel and cut the onion in thick round slices.
Cut each potato in two, lengthwise.
Peel the quinces, remove the seeds and cut them into four.
In a rectangle dish, add the pork roast, slaver it with cumin, salt, pepper and olive oil.
Add the potatoes around the meat, as well as the onion slices.
Put the dish in a cold oven, and cook at 180 °C for 30–40 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and add enough water to have 1 cm of water at the bottom. Put the dish back into the oven for 1.5 hours.
Remove the dish from the oven, cover it with some aluminum paper and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Use the onion from the dish as well as the remaining broth to make a sauce. Add them all to a blender and blend until homogeneous.
